description_sq:
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe e brendshme 53 m2 dhe siperfaqe totale 62 m2.
Organizohet ne:
- Ambjent ndenjeje dhe gatimi
- 1 Dhome gjumi
- 1 Tualet
- Ballkon
Zona e banimit do te ofroje nje shumellojshmeri ndertimesh qe i pershtaten cdo kategorie bleresi, shkolla publike brenda kompleksit, njesi te ndryshme sherbimi si dyqane, bare & restaurate, hapsira e gjelberuar, kënde të ndryshme sportive me parametra profesional, kënde lojërash për fëmijë, markete, lulishte, palestër, siguri 24 orë, mirëmbajtje ambjentesh të përbashkëta, transporti i vazhdueshëm urban Qendra - QTU - Univers City etj.
description_en: The apartment has an internal surface of 53 m2 and a total surface of 62 m2. It is organized in: - Living room and kitchen - 1 Bedroom - 1 Toilet - Balcony The residential area will offer a variety of buildings that suit every buyer category, public schools within the complex, various service units such as shops, bars & restaurants, green space, various sports areas with professional parameters, playgrounds for children, markets, flower gardens, gym, 24 hour security, maintenance of common areas, continuous urban transport Center - QTU - Univers City, etc.
